Kenan<WH07018>, Mahalaleel<WH04111>, Jered<WH03382>,
Henoch<WH02585>, Methuselah<WH04968>, Lamech<WH03929>,
Noah<WH05146>, Shem<WH08035>, Ham<WH02526>, and Japheth<WH03315>.
The sons<WH01121> of Japheth<WH03315>; Gomer<WH01586>, and Magog<WH04031>, and Madai<WH04074>, and Javan<WH03120>, and Tubal<WH08422>, and Meshech<WH04902>, and Tiras<WH08494>.
And the sons<WH01121> of Gomer<WH01586>; Ashchenaz<WH0813>, and Riphath<WH07384>, and Togarmah<WH08425>. <RF>Riphath: or, Diphath as it is in some copies<Rf>
And the sons<WH01121> of Javan<WH03120>; Elishah<WH0473>, and Tarshish<WH08659>, Kittim<WH03794>, and Dodanim<WH01721>. <RF>Dodanim: or, Rodanim, according to some copies<Rf>
The sons<WH01121> of Ham<WH02526>; Cush<WH03568>, and Mizraim<WH04714>, Put<WH06316>, and Canaan<WH03667>.

And the sons<WH01121> of Cush<WH03568>; Seba<WH05434>, and Havilah<WH02341>, and Sabta<WH05454>, and Raamah<WH07484>, and Sabtecha<WH05455>. And the sons<WH01121> of Raamah<WH07484>; Sheba<WH07614>, and Dedan<WH01719>.
And Cush<WH03568> begat<WH03205><WTH8804> Nimrod<WH05248>: he began<WH02490><WTH8689> to be mighty<WH01368> upon the earth<WH0776>.
And Mizraim<WH04714> begat<WH03205><WTH8804> Ludim<WH03866>, and Anamim<WH06047>, and Lehabim<WH03853>, and Naphtuhim<WH05320>,
And Pathrusim<WH06625>, and Casluhim<WH03695>, (of whom came<WH03318><WTH8804> the Philistines<WH06430>,) and Caphthorim<WH03732>.
And Canaan<WH03667> begat<WH03205><WTH8804> Zidon<WH06721> his firstborn<WH01060>, and Heth<WH02845>,
The Jebusite<WH02983> also, and the Amorite<WH0567>, and the Girgashite<WH01622>,
And the Hivite<WH02340>, and the Arkite<WH06208>, and the Sinite<WH05513>,
And the Arvadite<WH0721>, and the Zemarite<WH06786>, and the Hamathite<WH02577>.

The sons<WH01121> of Shem<WH08035>; Elam<WH05867>, and Asshur<WH0804>, and Arphaxad<WH0775>, and Lud<WH03865>, and Aram<WH0758>, and Uz<WH05780>, and Hul<WH02343>, and Gether<WH01666>, and Meshech<WH04902>. <RF>Meshech: or, Mash<Rf>
And Arphaxad<WH0775> begat<WH03205><WTH8804> Shelah<WH07974>, and Shelah<WH07974> begat<WH03205><WTH8804> Eber<WH05677>.

And unto Eber<WH05677> were born<WH03205><WTH8795> two<WH08147> sons<WH01121>: the name<WH08034> of the one<WH0259> <FI>was<Fi> Peleg<WH06389>; because in his days<WH03117> the earth<WH0776> was divided<WH06385><WTH8738>: and his brother's<WH0251> name<WH08034> <FI>was<Fi> Joktan<WH03355>. <RF>Peleg: that is, division<Rf>
And Joktan<WH03355> begat<WH03205><WTH8804> Almodad<WH0486>, and Sheleph<WH08026>, and Hazarmaveth<WH02700>, and Jerah<WH03392>,
Hadoram<WH01913> also, and Uzal<WH0187>, and Diklah<WH01853>,
And Ebal<WH05858>, and Abimael<WH039>, and Sheba<WH07614>,
And Ophir<WH0211>, and Havilah<WH02341>, and Jobab<WH03103>. All these <FI>were<Fi> the sons<WH01121> of Joktan<WH03355>.
Shem<WH08035>, Arphaxad<WH0775>, Shelah<WH07974>,
Eber<WH05677>, Peleg<WH06389>, Reu<WH07466>,
Serug<WH08286>, Nahor<WH05152>, Terah<WH08646>,
Abram<WH087>; the same <FI>is<Fi> Abraham<WH085>.<CM>
The sons<WH01121> of Abraham<WH085>; Isaac<WH03327>, and Ishmael<WH03458>.
These <FI>are<Fi> their generations<WH08435>: The firstborn<WH01060> of Ishmael<WH03458>, Nebaioth<WH05032>; then Kedar<WH06938>, and Adbeel<WH0110>, and Mibsam<WH04017>,
Mishma<WH04927>, and Dumah<WH01746>, Massa<WH04854>, Hadad<WH02301>, and Tema<WH08485>, <RF>Hadad: also called, Hadar<Rf>
Jetur<WH03195>, Naphish<WH05305>, and Kedemah<WH06929>. These are the sons<WH01121> of Ishmael<WH03458>.

Now the sons<WH01121> of Keturah<WH06989>, Abraham's<WH085> concubine<WH06370>: she bare<WH03205><WTH8804> Zimran<WH02175>, and Jokshan<WH03370>, and Medan<WH04091>, and Midian<WH04080>, and Ishbak<WH03435>, and Shuah<WH07744>. And the sons<WH01121> of Jokshan<WH03370>; Sheba<WH07614>, and Dedan<WH01719>.
And the sons<WH01121> of Midian<WH04080>; Ephah<WH05891>, and Epher<WH06081>, and Henoch<WH02585>, and Abida<WH028>, and Eldaah<WH0420>. All these <FI>are<Fi> the sons<WH01121> of Keturah<WH06989>.
And Abraham<WH085> begat<WH03205><WTH8686> Isaac<WH03327>. The sons<WH01121> of Isaac<WH03327>; Esau<WH06215> and Israel<WH03478>.
The sons<WH01121> of Esau<WH06215>; Eliphaz<WH0464>, Reuel<WH07467>, and Jeush<WH03266>, and Jaalam<WH03281>, and Korah<WH07141>.
The sons<WH01121> of Eliphaz<WH0464>; Teman<WH08487>, and Omar<WH0201>, Zephi<WH06825>, and Gatam<WH01609>, Kenaz<WH07073>, and Timna<WH08555>, and Amalek<WH06002>. <RF>Zephi: or, Zepho<Rf>
The sons<WH01121> of Reuel<WH07467>; Nahath<WH05184>, Zerah<WH02226>, Shammah<WH08048>, and Mizzah<WH04199>.
And the sons<WH01121> of Seir<WH08165>; Lotan<WH03877>, and Shobal<WH07732>, and Zibeon<WH06649>, and Anah<WH06034>, and Dishon<WH01787>, and Ezer<WH0687>, and Dishan<WH01789>.
And the sons<WH01121> of Lotan<WH03877>; Hori<WH02753>, and Homam<WH01950>: and Timna<WH08555> <FI>was<Fi> Lotan's<WH03877> sister<WH0269>. <RF>Homam: or, Hemam<Rf>

The sons<WH01121> of Shobal<WH07732>; Alian<WH05935>, and Manahath<WH04506>, and Ebal<WH05858>, Shephi<WH08195>, and Onam<WH0208>. And the sons<WH01121> of Zibeon<WH06649>; Aiah<WH0345>, and Anah<WH06034>. <RF>Alian: also called, Alvan<Rf> <RF>Shephi: also called, Shepho<Rf>
The sons<WH01121> of Anah<WH06034>; Dishon<WH01787>. And the sons<WH01121> of Dishon<WH01787>; Amram<WH02566>, and Eshban<WH0790>, and Ithran<WH03506>, and Cheran<WH03763>. <RF>Amram: or, Hemdan<Rf>
The sons<WH01121> of Ezer<WH0687>; Bilhan<WH01092>, and Zavan<WH02190>, <FI>and<Fi> Jakan<WH03292>. The sons<WH01121> of Dishan<WH01789>; Uz<WH05780>, and Aran<WH0765>. <RF>Jakan: or, Akan<Rf>

Now these <FI>are<Fi> the kings<WH04428> that reigned<WH04427><WTH8804> in the land<WH0776> of Edom<WH0123> before<WH06440> <FI>any<Fi> king<WH04428> reigned<WH04427><WTH8800> over the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>; Bela<WH01106> the son<WH01121> of Beor<WH01160>: and the name<WH08034> of his city<WH05892> <FI>was<Fi> Dinhabah<WH01838>.
And when Bela<WH01106> was dead<WH04191><WTH8799>, Jobab<WH03103> the son<WH01121> of Zerah<WH02226> of Bozrah<WH01224> reigned<WH04427><WTH8799> in his stead.
And when Jobab<WH03103> was dead<WH04191><WTH8799>, Husham<WH02367> of the land<WH0776> of the Temanites<WH08489> reigned<WH04427><WTH8799> in his stead.

And when Husham<WH02367> was dead<WH04191><WTH8799>, Hadad<WH01908> the son<WH01121> of Bedad<WH0911>, which smote<WH05221><WTH8688> Midian<WH04080> in the field<WH07704> of Moab<WH04124>, reigned<WH04427><WTH8799> in his stead: and the name<WH08034> of his city<WH05892> <FI>was<Fi> Avith<WH05762>.
And when Hadad<WH01908> was dead<WH04191><WTH8799>, Samlah<WH08072> of Masrekah<WH04957> reigned<WH04427><WTH8799> in his stead.
And when Samlah<WH08072> was dead<WH04191><WTH8799>, Shaul<WH07586> of Rehoboth<WH07344> by the river<WH05104> reigned<WH04427><WTH8799> in his stead.
And when Shaul<WH07586> was dead<WH04191><WTH8799>, Baalhanan<WH01177> the son<WH01121> of Achbor<WH05907> reigned<WH04427><WTH8799> in his stead.

And when Baalhanan<WH01177> was dead<WH04191><WTH8799>, Hadad<WH01908> reigned<WH04427><WTH8799> in his stead: and the name<WH08034> of his city<WH05892> <FI>was<Fi> Pai<WH06464>; and his wife's<WH0802> name<WH08034> <FI>was<Fi> Mehetabel<WH04105>, the daughter<WH01323> of Matred<WH04308>, the daughter<WH01323> of Mezahab<WH04314>. <RF>Hadad: or, Hadar<Rf> <RF>Pai: or, Pau<Rf>
Hadad<WH01908> died<WH04191><WTH8799> also. And the dukes<WH0441> of Edom<WH0123> were; duke<WH0441> Timnah<WH08555>, duke<WH0441> Aliah<WH05933>, duke<WH0441> Jetheth<WH03509>,
Duke<WH0441> Aholibamah<WH0173>, duke<WH0441> Elah<WH0425>, duke<WH0441> Pinon<WH06373>,
Duke<WH0441> Kenaz<WH07073>, duke<WH0441> Teman<WH08487>, duke<WH0441> Mibzar<WH04014>,
Duke<WH0441> Magdiel<WH04025>, duke<WH0441> Iram<WH05902>. These <FI>are<Fi> the dukes<WH0441> of Edom<WH0123>.<CM>
